name: Silver Thread: Un
source:
An exorcist who doubts the existence of ghosts might sound contradictory, but to Alicia Wilkershire, this is the best way to get closer to the truth. 

Her latest job seemed like another run-of-the-mill case, and she greeted her client with her usual pessimism – but is it really?

[From [url=https://spicaze.itch.io/silver-thread]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
驅魔師卻懷疑世上究竟有沒有鬼，這聽起來或許自相矛盾。但在艾莉西亞．威爾克希爾看來，要接近真相，這再合適不過。

新接的工作看起來又是樁稀鬆平常的案子，她照舊不抱什麼希望地接待了委託人。可這案子當真那麼尋常嗎？
